title: ianthe minuta
intro: Ianthe minuta, commonly known as Ianthe, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the family Iridaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of Ianthe minuta include its use in traditional medicine for treating various ailments, such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Ianthe minuta include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
